author: @fl0rianr

evidence.api_compatibility: The new models_generation and model_sync fields on GET /api/v1/health are additive and backwards-compatible; existing clients that do not understand them will simply ignore them. The new POST /internal/models/sync and GET /internal/models/sync/status endpoints are internal (not external API) and require admin auth. No existing API contract is broken.
evidence.documentation: The health endpoint schema in src/cpp/server/routes/lemonade/system/health.cpp is updated with descriptions for the new model_sync and models_generation fields, cross-referencing GET /internal/models/sync/status. No user-facing documentation (README, guides, release notes) is affected per the PR description checklist. The API doc update is consistent with the code change.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The PR changes two GUI surfaces: (1) a new per-model Update button shown when update_available=true, and (2) Update All now delegates to /internal/models/sync instead of issuing individual /api/v1/pull calls. It also adds a sync progress toast and a 'View logs' / dismiss UI for failures. No evidence shows a human exercised these GUI paths end-to-end — CI runs are sufficient for the TypeScript and C++ build but cannot validate the React UI interactions, progress toasts, or the corrected Update All behavior. The backend changes (models_generation in health API, sync outcome logging in C++) are also not manually validated.
evidence.post_approval_commits: One commit was added after @meghsat's approval (2026-10-28T17:06:57Z): 'fix(app): retry missed model sync results and reset state on disconnect' (efa7a2d). This commit fixes the baseline null-coalescing in onModelState, changes the disconnect retry condition from checking this.state.active to api.isConnected, and ensures error/result state is cleared on disconnect. A test was added covering the new behavior. This is a small bug fix within the spirit of the approved PR; it adds one test but no new behavior beyond fixing an edge case.
evidence.review: The PR was requested for review by @kpoineal and @jeremyfowers, but only @meghsat submitted an APPROVAL review. @fl0rianr has GUI listed as a subject area in docs/dev/contribute.md, which is appropriate. @meghsat contributed the co-authored 'edge cases fix' commit and appears to have hands-on familiarity with the sync store logic. CodeRabbit flagged a potential issue with handledModelSyncIds deduplication not distinguishing server restarts; this was addressed in a subsequent commit. There were no inline review comments from human reviewers on the main implementation.
evidence.security: The new endpoints use admin authentication. The /internal/models/sync endpoint delegates to the existing SyncService, which was already available. The client-side modelSyncStore makes authenticated API calls and dispatches a window event to navigate to server logs. No new credential handling, network calls to third parties, or permission changes. CodeRabbit did not flag security concerns.
evidence.tests: New test file model-sync-store.runtime.cjs (155 lines) tests the ModelSyncStore's start/poll/dismiss/reset cycle, including failure recovery, dismiss, and sync result tracking. A second test was added to global-model-settings.runtime.cjs (14 lines) as a bonus. The post-approval commit added inline tests for the retry-on-disconnect and missed-result scenarios. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: Open the Lemonade GUI, navigate to Models > a downloaded model with update_available=true, click the new Update button, and confirm the model updates and the toast shows progress.
In the Models list, click Update All on multiple downloaded models and confirm the server sync endpoint is called (single request) and progress is shown in the toast.
Navigate away from Models during a sync, then return and confirm the sync status is restored and the toast reflects the current state.
Verify the health API GET /api/v1/health returns the new model_sync and models_generation fields.

shout_outs.reason: Co-author of the commit and contributor of the 'edge cases fix: sync status and update reason' commit that resolved sync state tracking issues.

subject: fix(app): use server sync for individual and bulk model updates (#3957)
summary: Adds a per-model Update button in the GUI model details panel and replaces Update All's per-model /api/v1/pull calls with a single /internal/models/sync endpoint, while adding models_generation and model_sync fields to the health API and a ModelSyncStore client feature to track server-side sync progress, errors, and failures.
verdict_reason: The PR introduces new GUI surfaces — a per-model Update button and a changed Update All flow — but there is no evidence a human exercised these paths before merge.
